name: hviske-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence openrail, repo created 2024-09-27.

benchmarks.config: Card results table (| model | params | CER | WER |): syvai/hviske-v2 4.7% CER / 11.8% WER vs openai/whisper-large-v3 11.4% / 28.3%, both 1540M, same CoRal test rows. Lower is better. Card is in Danish and does not state the harness.
